caption: The drawing depicts a painted statue of a standing male figure on a rectangular pedestal. The figure is dressed in a red tunic with green and blue accents, a green belt, and patterned leggings. He wears shoes that are colored in brown and red tones. On his head is a green headdress decorated with three upright feathers in green, yellow, and reddish hues. The figure’s right hand is positioned on his chest, while his left hand is by his side and holds an object resembling a bundle of leaves or feathers. The pedestal is depicted in brown with lighter and darker variations suggesting wood grain. The background of the drawing is plain, untextured, and cream-colored. The artist's name, "Frances Lichten," is inscribed at the bottom right of the pedestal.
title: Cigar Store Indian
